job.job_description:
Agentic AI Developer (3-5 Years Experience)

Location: Infosys, India




Job Description:
Infosys is seeking an innovative Agentic AI Developer with 3-5 years of experience in software development and strong expertise in Python programming. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience designing and building autonomous AI agents, multi-agent systems, and GenAI-powered applications using modern AI frameworks and Large Language Models (LLMs).




Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and deploy Agentic AI solutions using LLMs and AI agent frameworks.
Build intelligent workflows and autonomous agents capable of reasoning, planning, and task execution.
Develop scalable Python-based applications, APIs, and microservices.
Integrate AI agents with enterprise systems, databases, APIs, and business applications.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and implement AI-driven business solutions.



Required Skills:

3-5 years of experience in Python development.
Hands-on experience with Agentic AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, and RAG architectures.
Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or similar.
Strong knowledge of FastAPI, Flask, REST APIs, and microservices architecture.
Experience working with vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, ChromaDB, Azure AI Search).
Familiarity with Azure Cloud and AI services.



Preferred Skills:

Experience with multi-agent orchestration and workflow automation.
Knowledge of LLMOps, AI governance, and model evaluation.
Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
